title: MicroCon Helper
description: Set the serial baud rate via the device control service (1200–921600).
initialStatus: Pick a baud rate, then click Apply.
outOfRange: ✗ Baud rate is out of range ({min}–{max}).
noSession: ✗ No BLE session found. Connect the device in a terminal first.
responseTimeout: Timed out waiting for the device response.
mcHelp:
{title} commands:
/mc status — show device status
/mc baud <rate> — set baud rate (1200–921600)
/mc reboot — restart the current device
/mc help — show this help
* First-letter abbreviations are accepted
mcStatusBadFrame: Device status frame could not be parsed.
toolbarUnavailable: The MicroCon Helper plugin is not installed or is disabled.
